question: In which of the year was Satara annexed under the Doctrine of Lapse?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1848**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• **Satara was annexed under the Doctrine of Lapse** in the year **1848**. This policy was introduced by Lord Dalhousie, the Governor-General of India from 1848 to 1856. 
• The **Doctrine of Lapse** allowed the British East India Company to annex territories of princely states where the ruler died without a male heir. 
• Satara was one of the first princely states to be annexed under this doctrine. The death of the ruler, **Shahaji II**, without a legitimate male heir provided the justification for annexation. 
• The policy was aimed at consolidating British control over India by acquiring territories that were deemed “lapsed” due to succession issues.
